The '''Sea of Sponges''' was a naturally occurring feature located on the predominantly uninhabitable tropical [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. Drongar was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
